title: SAABs
summary: A repository containing a Java-based UML/design tool ("rversedesigner") with a package named com.sdmetrics, unrelated to any synthetic data workflow; no README or code ties it to the Synthetic Data Vault ecosystem, and the "sdmetrics" path is simply a Java package name collision with SDV's sdmetrics library.
evidence: Directory path rversedesigner/src/com/sdmetrics is a Java package (com.sdmetrics) for a UML tool, not the SDV sdmetrics library
needs: Confirm com.sdmetrics is unrelated Java UML software, not SDV's sdmetrics package
